subject: Archaeology
title: Homo Naledi in Rising Star Cave
description: A fast breakdown of Homo Naledi in Rising Star Cave for builders.

hook.text: In South Africa, cavers squeezed through a 7-inch gap and found a chamber full of ancient bones.

buildup.text: The chamber held remains of at least 15 individuals from a previously unknown human relative.

discovery.text: Homo naledi had a tiny brain but walked upright and had hands shaped for making tools.

twist.text: The bones were only 250,000 years old — meaning naledi lived alongside early Homo sapiens in Africa.

climax.text: The bodies appear deliberately placed, suggesting naledi may have practiced burial — a shock for their brain size.

punchline.text: A small-brained relative may have buried their dead, just like us.

quiz.question: What surprised scientists most about Homo naledi?
options: They were much taller than modern humans
Despite small brains, they may have practiced deliberate burial
Their bones contained traces of cooked food
